review_cost.rationale: Nothing structural needs rework, but the history bug, the oversized page component and the tsconfig downgrade are things I'd ask for before approving — one round of changes, all small.

findings.issue: Filter changes use history.pushState but there is no popstate handler, so pressing back/forward updates the URL while the page keeps showing stale results.
findings.suggestion: Listen for popstate and re-run the fetch-and-swap, or use replaceState and let back/forward do full navigations.

findings.issue: The detail page is ~390 lines with all move/version-group/type shaping inline in frontmatter; the heaviest logic in the app lives in a route file.
findings.suggestion: Extract version-group selection and move-row shaping (lines 88-186) into src/lib/moves.ts so the page is mostly markup.

findings.issue: API_BASE_URL is read straight from process.env; since Astro 5 the docs recommend astro:env (getSecret or a schema) for programmatic env access.
findings.suggestion: Define an envField.string schema in astro.config.mjs and read it via astro:env/server, keeping the adapter-swap benefit.

findings.issue: The same memoize-and-reset-on-error boilerplate is duplicated for all seven cached resources.
findings.suggestion: Add a small `cached(fn)` wrapper in lib and let each getter use it.

findings.issue: getVersionGroup/getMove/getTypeDetail fetches run outside any error handling; a single bad API response becomes an uncaught 500.
findings.suggestion: Wrap the enrichment block and degrade gracefully (omit type labels / render '—') rather than failing the whole page.

findings.issue: strict:false disables the type checking astro/tsconfigs/base enables by default, weakening every downstream edit.
findings.suggestion: Remove the override and type the API payloads in lib/data.ts.

findings.issue: Text-column sorting uses plain localeCompare, so an empty type/category value sorts first when ascending instead of last as the spec requires for missing values.
findings.suggestion: Apply the same empty-value guard used for numericKeys to the text branch of compare().

findings.issue: The 18 per-type color rules are duplicated verbatim for .type-badge and .type-link.
findings.suggestion: Share one selector list (.type-badge, .type-link) or generate the rules from the token names.

findings.issue: Dex-number formatting is repeated inline instead of reusing the existing dexNumber() helper.
findings.suggestion: Import dexNumber from ../../lib/pokeapi and use it here.

findings.issue: The client script fetches and parses the entire rendered page on every (debounced) keystroke just to replace #results, and its coupling to the server markup makes the template hard to change safely.
findings.suggestion: Consider replacing the swap with Astro's standard navigation or a small fetch endpoint that returns only the results fragment.

summary: This is a solid, current-version Astro SSR app: routing, params, status codes and data loading all follow the documented patterns, and the error handling and race guards show real care. The main reservations are a hand-rolled DOM-swap navigation with a history desync bug, a god data module built on seven copies of the same memoization boilerplate, and a 390-line detail page. I'd merge it after one round of small, well-scoped changes.
